title: Largest Multiple Of Three
description: Given an array of digits, return the largest multiple of three that can be formed by concatenating some of the digits in any order.

steps.note: Sort digits in descending order to prioritize larger values.
Distribute digits into buckets based on modulo 3.
Calculate the total sum of digits.
Sum 19 % 3 is 1. Remove one digit from bucket 1.
Concatenate remaining digits to form the largest multiple.
